home.title: Buy or sell with someone who thinks like an operator.
home.intro: Room 305 helps buyers and sellers look at the building before the brochure. We focus on South Florida condos where ownership, rules, guest use, and exit path need a sharper read.

building.title: Building-specific judgment
building.body: We look at rules, owner use, and practical friction one building at a time.

operator.title: Operator perspective
operator.body: We think beyond the closing table: setup, handoff, rhythm, and what ownership feels like after month one.

foreign.title: Foreign and absentee fluency
foreign.body: Distance changes the decision. The first call should make the next step clearer, not heavier.

founder.title: Founder-led calls
founder.body: If the fit is real, you speak with Isaac or the Room 305 team before any next step.

home.founderTitle: Isaac reads the building before the pitch.
home.founderBody: Isaac's work starts with what the building allows, what the owner wants, and what the operation would have to carry after a purchase or sale. The useful call is not a broad tour. It is a focused conversation about the property, the rules, and the reality around it.
home.founderQuote: Tell us what you are trying to decide. We will bring the building context, and if it is not a fit, we will say that early.
home.closeTitle: You do not have to sort the building alone.
home.closeBody: When you narrow the decision to a building, a unit, or a sale question, the next step should feel lighter. We review the context before replying, then keep the call short and useful.

showroom.title: The corridor we cover, by building.
showroom.body: Hallandale to Brickell, plus the adjacent branded-residence edges. These are buildings we currently follow; cadence labels stay methodological until declaration lookups clear.
